assertions.source: Scoping probe: enumerates the 3 partitions of n=3 (proton braid 𝓑₃ Wedderburn blocks): (3), (2,1), (1,1,1). Concrete numerical data: y_λ(q_0) placeholder values + dim_q sanity check. Full per-block c_k extraction is future work.
